name: Supabase Auth
summary: Supabase Auth is a built-in login system that handles sign-up, sign-in, sessions, and social logins for a Supabase project.

free_plan_covers.note: Auth alone allows 50,000 monthly active users on the free plan, more than a typical small app needs.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Billed on the same Pro plan as the database, from $25/month, which raises the included limit to 100,000 monthly active users.

portability.note: The underlying Auth server is open source and self-hostable, but user records and tokens are Supabase-specific to migrate.

mobile_sdk.note: Official SDKs cover Flutter, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), and React Native through the same client libraries as the database.

prebuilt_ui.note: The old Auth UI React package is unmaintained; Supabase now ships ready-made sign-in screens through its official UI Library instead.

builtin_email_production_ready.note: Built-in sending is capped at 2 emails per hour and is explicitly not meant for production; Supabase says to add custom SMTP.

setup.step: Create a free Supabase account and a new project at supabase.com.
Scaffold a Next.js app using the official Supabase starter template, which includes working sign-up and login pages.
Copy the Project URL and publishable key from the project's Connect panel in the dashboard.
Add the URL and key to your environment file.
Optionally add polished sign-in and sign-up screens from the official Supabase UI Library.

builder_notes: Never expose the secret key to the browser; only the publishable key belongs in client-side code.
Pair every protected table with a Row Level Security policy that checks auth.uid(); Auth alone does not restrict database rows.
Skip the old @supabase/auth-ui-react package since it is unmaintained; use the official Supabase UI Library for prebuilt screens instead.
